validation.summary: The candidate implements the overall structure and design tokens well, but fails on several critical layout and animation requirements. The hero section cards overflow their container and are cut off. The scroll-linked animations for the Problem/Solution section use time-based transitions instead of mapping directly to scroll progress. The Clinical Support scrolling list has incorrect padding, causing the scroll choreography to misalign with the highlight box.
strengths: Good use of Tailwind for styling and design token implementation.
Mega menus are implemented with accessible hover/focus states.
The SVG morphing logic for the converging lines is a good approach.

issues.title: Hero Section Cards Overflow
issues.observed: The three UI cards in the right side of the hero section are too wide for their container on desktop, causing the third card (RCM) to overflow and be hidden or cut off.
issues.expected: All three cards should be fully visible side-by-side within the right column on desktop screens.
issues.fix_instructions: Reduce the width of the `.hero-mockup-card` inner containers (e.g., change `lg:w-[260px]` to `lg:w-[200px]`) and reduce the gap in their parent flex container (e.g., change `lg:gap-8` to `lg:gap-4`) so they fit within the 50% width column.

issues.title: Missing Hero Entrance Animation
issues.observed: The hero section background panels appear instantly on load, and only the inner cards animate.
issues.expected: As seen in the reference video, the entire hero section (the green and blue panels) should slide up and fade in on page load, followed by the sequenced card animations.
issues.fix_instructions: Add an entrance animation (fade in and slide up) to the main grid container or the two colored panels in the hero section, triggering on page load before the card sequence begins.

issues.title: Problem/Solution Crossfade is Not Scroll-Linked
issues.observed: The text crossfade in the Problem/Solution section uses a hard threshold (0.4) to trigger a time-based CSS transition (`transition-opacity duration-500`).
issues.expected: The opacity of the text should be directly mapped to the scroll progress, so the fade is perfectly synchronized with the user's scrolling, as specified in the requirements.
issues.fix_instructions: Remove the CSS transitions for opacity on `#anim-text-problem` and `#anim-text-solution`. In the scroll event listener, calculate the opacity directly based on `morphProgress` (e.g., `animTextProblem.style.opacity = 1 - morphProgress; animTextSolution.style.opacity = morphProgress;`).

issues.title: Clinical Support List Padding Incorrect
issues.observed: The scrolling list in the Clinical Support section has `py-[15vh]`. Because the highlight box is `sticky top-1/2`, the first text item is already above the highlight box when the section comes into view.
issues.expected: The first item should start below the center and scroll up into the highlight box. The padding must allow the first and last items to reach the vertical center of the screen.
issues.fix_instructions: Change the padding on the `#capabilities-list` container from `py-[15vh]` to `pt-[50vh] pb-[50vh]` (or similar values) to ensure proper scroll choreography.

issues.title: Benefits Cards Hidden in Static View
issues.observed: The cards in the 'Why Ease' section are hidden by default via JS and rely on IntersectionObserver to appear. In static rendering contexts (like the full-page screenshot), they remain invisible.
issues.expected: Content should ideally be visible if JS fails or hasn't triggered, or the observer should be configured to ensure they appear reliably.
issues.fix_instructions: Consider adding a fallback or adjusting the IntersectionObserver `rootMargin` to ensure the cards trigger more reliably, or apply the hidden state via a `.js-enabled` class so they are visible by default without JS.

patch_instructions: In the Hero section, update the mockup container classes: change `gap-6 lg:gap-8` to `gap-4 lg:gap-6`.
In the Hero section, update the card inner div classes: change `w-[220px] lg:w-[260px]` to `w-[180px] lg:w-[210px]`.
Add a CSS animation or JS logic to slide up and fade in the `.bg-brand-lightgreen` and `.bg-brand-lightblue` panels on initial load.
In the `#capabilities-list` div, change `py-[15vh]` to `pt-[45vh] pb-[45vh]`.

In the scroll event listener for `#scroll-anim-section`, remove the `if/else` block that toggles classes based on `threshold`. Instead, directly set `animTextProblem.style.opacity = 1 - morphProgress` and `animTextSolution.style.opacity = morphProgress`.
Remove `transition-opacity duration-500` from `#anim-text-problem` and `#anim-text-solution` to allow instant updates via JS.
